What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive array of services all under one roof to provide you with a safe, convenient, and hassle-free pet care experience. We are a full service concierge service that offers walking services, pet boarding, pet grooming, medication administration and other services that will meet your everyday pet care requirements.

From standard dog walking to full grooming, ear cleaning, and more, our professionally trained pet care staff is here to attend to your fur babies. Transportation for exsisting Petiquette Pooch Confierge clients is included at no charge. Outside of the Seaport, there will be a minimal charge for transportation.

Why Choose Us

We're here to rescue your time and give you the zen to kick back and enjoy life's adventures. Your furry pals are our VIPs, getting the royal treatment and top-notch care.

With our straightforward pricing and all-inclusive services, we keep things simple. Only the finest for your pets—all products are made in the USA.

WHERE DOGGIE DAY CARE MEETS A LIFESTYLE
Peace of mind that your dog is always in a safe and loving environment.

Our goal at the Harbor Hounds is to provide a clean, safe and productive environment for your dog during their stay with us. At Harbor Hounds we focus and prioritize each dogs needs throughout the day. Not only will your dog be coming home tired, but better behaved and appropriately socialized. Additionally, we have an outdoor area where your dog will have potty breaks and fresh air every two hours. When the weather is permitting, we spend hours outside where are the dogs get to lounge on dog beds or enjoy our dog pools.

What you can expect from us
We aren't like all the other day cares. We focus on having a well-behaved friendly environment where your dog can play, rest and learn. Our pack dynamic is kept smaller than most daycares to ensure the safety and well-being of your dog. We have a 1:10 staff to dog ratio and all of our staff is trained in dog behavior, safe play, and health. Not all day care centers have to be filled with barking and bad mannered dogs! Our facility along with our outdoor area is sanitized daily with veterinarian grade products. At Harbor Hounds we practice a structured environment where your dog will learn appropriate manners, socializing and more!

When you pick your dog up
When you pick your dog up, you will be able to speak with a staff member who has spent the day with your dog and will happily answer any questions you may have or to even just hear about their day at HH, Our staff will communicate any issues or concerns they may have noticed through out the day about your loved one.

My first rescue, was my dog Oakley-my best friend and love of my life. Dear Loyal LaundroMutt-Cambridge Community
Last bath day: Sunday, April 26
For the month of April, the Cambridge location will be open limited hours. We would like to invite you to join us for a customer appreciation “Last Bath” Event Weekend on Saturday April 25th and Sunday April 26th. 

After 22 years of fur-flying service, we have come to the difficult decision to consolidate our efforts. We are going to close LaundroMutt-Cambridge, New England’s first and oldest Self Service Dog Wash, in order to focus our energies on the two BYOD Dog Wash locations in Newton Centre and South Boston.

We want to THANK our loyal community for the years of memories, generous support and many fur-baby friendships at this location. We are so proud to have served this community and truly appreciate all the support of this small family business.

Promoting the health and wellness of dogs through bathing, a healthy diet, and mental and physical stimulation.

DIY baths, drop-off baths, and full grooming: we have it all. We also stock a variety of food, treats, gear and accessories, wellness products, and more.

For store hours, check individual stores under Locations in the menu.

DIY Bath
All you need is a dirty dog!

Just walk in and wash your own dog. We provide state-of-the-art stainless steel bathtubs, shampoo mixing units for shampoos, forced-air dryers, towels and brushes. And don’t worry, our friendly staff will get you and your dog set up, help you along the way and clean up after you!  Learn more.

Drop-Off Bath
We do the dirty work for you! (weekdays only)

We offer a drop–off dog wash service by appointment where one of our floor staff will wash your dog for you. This option is for owners who might not have the time to do it yourself or would rather not deal with the mess. Just drop off for up to 1 hour, run some errands and come pick up your sparkling clean pooch! Learn more.

Grooming
A trip to the doggie spa!

Our full-service dog grooming includes bathing, cleaning of the ears (plucking if necessary), nail trim, blow dry, brush out, sanitary-area clean up, trimming and hair cut. Would you like your dog’s teeth brushed? Our groomers will make them sparkle! Your dog will look and feel fabulous! Learn more.

ABOUT US

Mark Armour (founder & co-owner), originally from Belfast, Ireland, settled in Boston in 1998 after traveling the world for years. He has worn many hats in his lifetime – chef, bricklayer, travel agent, skydiving instructor, and restaurant manager, to name a few. Check out his blog Here!

 

Mark Walter (co-owner & operations manager), originally from North Carolina, moved to the Boston area in 1997 to attend graduate school for violin performance. He never even started the program, though – sheer panic about the musician’s life forced him to pack up his instrument and go to work behind the scenes of various arts organizations.

​

The pair moved to Dorchester in 2005. When Mark A’s brother- and sister-in-law needed help with their Watertown/Belmont dog-walking company, Active Paws, he assisted them for a couple of weeks. He quickly realized he had found his life’s passion and decided to bring quality dog walking to Dorchester & South Boston. The Pooped Pooch grew exponentially, and Mark W was onboard within a year, both taking care of pets and running the business side of things.

​

After years of caring for animals, the Marks have accumulated a good amount of knowledge about the pet food industry.  Thus was born The Pooped Pooch Pet Supply, now located in both Lower Mills and Savin Hill. The focus of the stores is on natural and holistic pet products, and the Marks are stocking the small shops full of healthy and fun items that were previously unavailable on a local level.

At Mimados, we believe grooming should be a positive and enjoyable experience for every pet. The name “Mimados” means “pampered” in Portuguese—and that’s exactly the experience we strive to provide every day.
My name is Hiago Loiola, and I have been professionally grooming pets for over 13 years. My journey began in 2012, when I was just 15 years old. My mother, a dedicated entrepreneur and one of the strongest people I have ever known, encouraged me to pursue this profession and inspired my love and respect for animals. She taught me the values that continue to guide me today: hard work, perseverance, integrity, and the importance of treating every living being with kindness.
When I moved to the United States in 2021, I carried those lessons with me. After my mother’s unexpected passing in 2022, I was determined to honor her legacy by building something that reflected the values she worked so hard to instill in me. One year later, with the help of a special friend who trusted in my values ​​and knowledge, I opened the first Mimados location.
Today, Mimados is more than a grooming salon—it’s a place where pets are treated like family. We proudly offer a cage-free environment designed to help pets feel comfortable, relaxed, and at home. Whether your pet enjoys socializing and playing or needs a quieter, private space, we tailor our care to their individual personality and needs.
Our mission is simple: to provide exceptional grooming services while creating a safe, loving, and stress-free experience for every pet that walks through our doors.
At Mimados, your furry family members receive the same level of care, patience, and dedication that has guided me throughout my career and continues to inspire everything we do.
We look forward to welcoming you and your pet to the Mimados family.

Explore Daycare
Overnight Lodging

From private suites to cage-free cuddle spaces, our lodging is designed for total relaxation. Each room features raised bedding, soft music, and personalized attention. With trained staff on-site day and night, you can rest easy knowing your pup is cared for around the clock.

Explore Lodging
Grooming

Everything from gentle baths and haircuts to coat conditioning, de-shedding, and pawdicures. Our groomers use high end products that leave coats soft, skin healthy, and dogs smelling amazing. Grooming services seven days a week, ensuring your dog always looks and feels their best

Explore Dog Grooming
Physical Rehabilitation

From post-surgery recovery to mobility challenges and strength conditioning, our certified rehab team helps dogs heal, build confidence, and move with comfort. Programs include treadmill therapy, balance and conditioning exercises, as well as fitness and conditioning.

Explore Rehabilitation
All-Inclusive Pet Retreat

From daycare to lodging, grooming, and physical rehab, we’ve got your dog’s every need covered in one convenient location.

All-Inclusive Pet Retreat
Staffed 24/7

Day or night, our team is on-site, watching over every bark, yawn, and playful jump with loving attention. Lodging pups are never left alone.

Staffed 24/7
High Safety Standards

We maintain strict safety with supervised play, clean comfortable spaces, and a low staff-to-dog ratio of 1:12–15. Outdoor yards are reinforced with underground mesh to keep even determined diggers safe.

High Safety Standards
State-Of-The-Art Facility

Built with a hi-flow air system featuring UV sanitizing light that kills 99.9% of viruses, bacteria, mold, and pathogens—helping prevent the spread of illness. Our cleaning system uses only animal-safe solutions throughout.

State-Of-The-Art Facility
Luxury All Over

Multiple indoor & outdoor play parks keep pups active and happy. Our largest indoor park has cushioned flooring to protect joints, while our outdoor spaces provide fresh air and safe social play.

Luxury All Over
Training

We’re thrilled to announce our partnership with MSPCA–Angell. Together, we’re bringing professional, reward-based training group classes right to our facility. Their certified behaviorist focus on building confidence, good manners, and stronger bonds between dogs and their families.

Whether you’re starting with a new puppy or helping an older dog refine their skills, MSPCA–Angell’s small-group classes offer the structure and support every dog needs to succeed.

Learn More
Keep Dogs On A Non-Retractable Leash With A Well-Fitted Harness Or Martingale.

We understand your dog may be great off-leash; however, with our facility located right next to a busy road and the highway, it is not worth the risk. Leash security is essential for everyone’s safety.

Give Space To Other Dogs Waiting Outside The Door.

Some dogs may be reactive,or nervous on leash. Please avoid leash greetings, even if dogs know each other from daycare. On-leash interactions can lead to barrier frustration, tension, or defensive behavior.

Call Upon Arrival For Our Main Unit.

Our main-unit door is locked 24/7 for safety reasons.

When you arrive, please call, and a staff member will let you in.

The doorbell is for use during off-hours when phones are offline.

Supervise Children Closely.

Not all dogs are comfortable around children, and loud noises or quick movements can increase stress for pets waiting in the lobby or outside.

Please keep children calm, nearby, and supervised at all times.

Whether your pet is here for a day or a month, they are part of our family.

Boarding and Daycare Frequently Asked Questions
I’m looking for Boston dog boarding. Is Toureen located in Boston?

Toureen Pet Resort & Spa is located in Watertown, MA, offering a convenient alternative to the hustle and traffic of downtown Boston. If you’re searching for Boston dog boarding, Toureen provides easy access from the Greater Boston area without the challenges of navigating busy city streets, ensuring a stress-free drop-off and pick-up experience for you and your pet.

When is the best time to visit and tour the facility?

You’re welcome to visit anytime we’re open (M-F from 8-6; Sat 8-5; Sun 10-5). However, in order to avoid waiting for us to finish serving our clients during busy drop-off and pick-up times, we recommend avoiding the first or last two hours of the day.  The mid-morning to mid-afternoon timing will also provide you with the best sense of what our supervised daycare and boarding areas are like when most of our guests are here.

Do I need to make a reservation, or call ahead, before bringing my dog or cat for daycare?

We only require a reservation for your pet’s first day with us, when we will orient and assess them to ensure the best possible experience for them – and you!  Otherwise, returning clients do not need to make a reservation.

Do I need to bring food for my dog or cat?

The food we serve is Science Diet – Sensitive Stomach brand, but you are welcome to provide any meals or treats that your dog or cat prefers, or requires due to allergies.  For any food you provide, we would appreciate it in labeled zip-top bags (pre-measured is preferable, but not required).

Can my dog play outside?

Yes! We maintain a large, safe, and sanitary outside space for dogs to explore and enjoy the freedom and fun of playing and socializing with new and old friends. Our caring, energetic supervisory staff thoughtfully separates groups of dogs by age, size and personality, and works to ensure that each guest enjoys a balanced, healthy day.

Welcome To The Pack

 

The Dog Scoop, located in West Newton, Massachusetts, is a pioneer in canine daycare and boarding. A Best of Boston pick, The Dog Scoop is known for its caring, experienced staff, and its outstanding customer service. The Dog Scoop operates with an “Open Pack” concept with plenty of indoor and outdoor areas for dogs to play, socialize, and relax. We believe in letting your dog be a dog!

 

The Dog Scoop’s popular daycare program has been operating since 2003. We also provide boarding and bathing services in our on-site grooming facility, part of the expanded grooming and boarding space we opened in December 2012.

 

The Dog Scoop is committed to providing your dog with a happy, safe, enjoyable environment whether it’s for a day, an overnight, or during your extended vacation. Call (617) 244-8944 for more information today!
